tools.name: search_servers
tools.description: Search the HardwareMCP catalog of MCP servers for physical hardware (ESP32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, 3D printers like Bambu/Prusa/Klipper/OctoPrint, Home Assistant, cameras, Zigbee, serial, oscilloscopes). Returns matching servers sorted by GitHub stars.

tools.name: get_server
tools.description: Get full details for one server by slug: what it does, requirements, install commands, notes, and the MCP client config snippet copied from its README.

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List every device family in the catalog with how many MCP servers support it.

tools.name: recommend_for_device
tools.description: Recommend the best MCP servers for a specific device, optionally for a goal (e.g. 'monitor prints', 'flash firmware', 'control lights'). Prefers maintained servers with ready client configs.
